title: CADGR1: compressed adaptive robust threshold-block search

claims.statement: For CADGR1 in proof.md, label-tools.md and fast-arithmetic.md, for every integer N>=2 and every s in Z/NZ let n=ceil(log2 N), m=1024(n+20), r=floor(5m/16), A=n+20 and p=n+ceil(log2 m)+40. Use the specified compressed threshold-block algorithm, counted approximate-gradient preparation and exact integer Grover schedule, including its finite n=1 branch. Under every joint input allowed by the fixed-position corruption model and floor(5Q/16) tolerance below, unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3, including clean ideal input. On every execution branch the same algorithm has total sequential work T=O(2^(n/2+64sqrt(log2 n)) n^2 (log2 n)^2) for n>=2, with fixed absolute cost for n=1, jointly with all other resource bounds. All constants are absolute. The supported envelope B(n)=2^(n/2+64sqrt(log2 n)) n^2 (log2 n)^2 for n>=2 has exact growth index 1. Complete preparation, precision, uniform circuits, addressing, inverse work and source counts are proved in the evidence.

For the same CADGR1 configuration in proof.md, label-tools.md and fast-arithmetic.md, for every N>=2 and s, n=ceil(log2 N) and actual acquired count Q=1024(n+20), the guaranteed malformed-copy threshold is tau(n,Q)=floor(5Q/16), with ordinary integer floor. Under the fixed-position corruption model in structured error_model, every allowed joint state at or below that count retains unconditional full-secret success greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds jointly on every branch, including gradient aborts. Clean independent ideal input is included. No larger-tolerance impossibility or per-copy corruption probability is asserted.

structured.error_model: Among Q acquired source copies, at most tau(n,Q) positions fixed before the algorithm private randomness may contain an arbitrary joint state on their declared source registers. Every other copy is an independent ideal coset state for the same fixed secret s; their product state is independent of the malformed subsystem. The adversary may know N,s and the algorithm but cannot alter the controller or registers after delivery. Malformed copies may be mutually entangled. The algorithm is not told the malformed positions.
